name: Westfield MainPlace
description: Westfield MainPlace is a premier enclosed shopping destination in the heart of Santa Ana, offering an exceptional retail experience with flagship department stores, popular fashion brands, diverse dining options, and family-friendly entertainment. As part of the renowned Westfield portfolio, this regional mall provides convenient amenities including Smart Parking technology and click-and-collect services while hosting community events and seasonal experiences. The center combines world-class shopping with engaging entertainment in a comfortable, climate-controlled environment perfect for all-day visits.
demographics: Serves the diverse Santa Ana community and surrounding Orange County areas with a mix of middle to upper-middle income shoppers
summary: A dynamic regional shopping mall in Santa Ana featuring major department stores, diverse retailers, dining, and entertainment with modern conveniences for Orange County shoppers.
